other_conditions: Applicants must possess or own a working loom(s).
Both individual women weavers and groups of women weavers are eligible to apply; companies and partnership firms are not eligible.
There is no restriction based on unit size or the number of looms; all categories and scales of women weavers are eligible.
benefits_summary: Provides women weavers with a 7% interest subvention on short‑term loans and access to affordable credit for working capital.
